title: Arcane Index Reference: Core Loop
summary: Search, compare, follow relations, and act with a precise Arcana record.

blocks.title: Search
blocks.body: Enter the clue you have: a name, item, ritual, school, curse, or bridge token.

blocks.title: Compare
blocks.body: Read discovery state, warning state, requirements, and relations before committing resources.

blocks.title: Act
blocks.body: Use the page to choose the next field test, archive read, ritual layout, spell cast, or curse-cleansing target.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
